text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's easier to measure when we're 
closer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Looking at her height... she's 
just a wee bit shorter than me, I 
reckon...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? Whaddya want, whaddya want! You two 
come here looking for a fight or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I'm just checkin' your height! I'm 
modelin' for a magazine soon, see! So I 
gotta study some poses!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you just go ask City about that? 
Why do you always gotta come bugging me?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Inari, you're pretty much the same height 
as me, right? Thought lookin' at you from 
the side would make a great reference! 
Come on, turn sideways! Lemme measure your 
width!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, 'for reference'?! 
Besides, width has got nothin' to do with 
it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aargh! Just shut up and let me take your 
measurements!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Why are ya so eager to measure me?! Hold 
on... Hey, you two ain't plottin' 
something, are ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Tamamo-senpai, why don't you just be 
honest? You don't really want to fight on 
a day like this, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... ...Actually, I was thinkin' of 
givin' ya some clothes for your birthday. 
I just wanted to take your measurements... 
Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Is that how it is...!? Aaaaargh! Alright! 
I ain't heard a single thing! Here, 
measure whatever ya want!"
